source_revision_evidence: the official v0.10.1 lightweight tag resolves directly to this commit

path_choice.selected: one-shot apply_spectral_sub with the upstream asymmetric full-length Hann STFT
path_choice.reason: upstream documents the two as algorithmically different, not numerically equivalent; exactly one path is pinned here and the online variant is not mixed in
path_choice.note: no iterative Wiener filtering and no noisereduce pooling are used anywhere in this arm

measured_character: With these pinned parameters the minimum-power noise estimate tracks a dominant tonal signal, so residual error against a clean reference rises rather than falls on a tone-plus-broadband-noise probe. This is recorded so the arm is not read as an improvement by default; the 30-condition corpus run is the authority on quality.
runtime: Python 3.12.14, pyroomacoustics 0.10.1, numpy/scipy, device cpu, no network
